description.en: An example extension built only on cmux-extension-sdk: browse with the keyboard. f labels the links on screen and typing a label follows it; b goes back, a bookmarks, D saves the images, y copies the URL, / finds. Every key can be rebound.

scopes.browser:execute: Draw the hint labels on the page you are on, save its images and find text in it.
scopes.browser:write: Go back, and open a link in a new tab.
scopes.actions:run: Bookmark the page and copy its address, the way cmux's own commands do.
scopes.storage:local: Keep the keys you choose on this Mac.
